body_markdown:
## The Signal Behind the Noise


*Ten minutes of reading. A month of moves your competitors haven’t made yet. Every signal below comes with the action it demands.*


#### Where the Money's Moving


1. [GAO Sustains MAPS Protests, Army Faces Reopen Call:](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/allison-gregory-01a09872_official-maps-update-protest-sustained-activity-7493377662942543872-m413?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAADQoNokBX--OMx7Jx7S-0Jn02LhogmPN1fc) Rework your pricing now. GAO sustained two MAPS protests on teaming grounds, recommending the Army reopen the $50B vehicle. Army can decline, risking a COFC fight. With 8 protests still open, Sept awards are off the table. Stay up to date with all things MAPS with Allison Gregory.


2. [VA Adds $17B to Oracle EHR Deal](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/019ff1b9-57d7-77c9-8301-6c8fb58d65b9--da01-va-ehrm-idiq-contract-36c10b18d5000-expanded-scope-modification-p00008-va-2?searchId=01a034f3-1c67-7728-ba5a-98ed6de4cad8&position=1) : Get in front of the prime now. A new mod extends VA’s Oracle Health EHR effort three years, locking in years of subcontracting runway.


3. [DISA Drafts a $21.6B Cloud Buy](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/019a4ac5-dc5f-731d-9dc2-c7b16d54ee3e--jwcc-ucm-core-draft-solicitation?searchId=01a034f4-911b-74cb-93f5-5ee382690527&position=1) : Comment during the draft window; that’s the cheapest seat before criteria lock. JWCC UCM Core draft sets terms for a decade of DOD cloud spend.


4. [DIU Launches Bridge Program to Kill Adoption Bottlenecks](https://www.war.gov/News/News-Stories/Article/Article/4575421/defense-innovation-unit-develops-program-to-supercharge-defense-industrial-base/) : Bridge is built to unstick that blocker. New unit targets clearance, classified space, & accreditation delays blocking commercial prototypes from fielding.


5. [80+ Firms Form New SB Alliances Ahead of GWAC On-Ramps](https://orangeslices.ai/new-small-business-alliances-signal-competitive-positioning-by-80-it-and-consulting-leaders-across-fedciv-fedhealth-and-dow/) : Map who’s aligning; alliances often preview the next on-ramp. IT & consulting leaders teaming up before the next OASIS+, SEWP VI, and Alliant decisions.


6. [L3Harris Ousts CEO Kubasik](https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/l3harris-names-insider-sam-mehta-ceo-christopher-kubasik-steps-down-2026-08-17/) : Watch for continuity signals if you sit on an L3Harris team. A conduct breach ousted Kubasik; insider Sam Mehta becomes CEO.


7. [Army Moves Cloud Management Under Cyber Command](https://www.dvidshub.net/news/573181/enterprise-cloud-management-activity-officially-assigned-under-arcyber) : Cloud providers on Army contracts should expect a more security-first posture on the next round of TOs. Army shifted cloud management under ARCYBER.


#### From the Field


1. [Court Kills B&P Cost Recovery on CIO-SP4](https://orangeslices.ai/cio-sp4-challengers-asked-for-their-bid-and-proposal-costs-back-court-says-no/) : Protesters asked for B&P costs back after their CIO-SP4 challenge failed, and the court refused. Budget B&P as sunk cost on future GWAC pursuits.


2. [CMMC Phase 1 Still Fully in Effect](https://orangeslices.ai/cmmc-pause-fact-vs-fiction-with-eric-nusbaum/) : Despite the pause headline, ENcompass Consulting Group CEO Eric Nusbaum confirms CMMC Phase 1 hasn’t moved. Keep SPRS documentation current, since this is where compliance teams keep tripping up.


3. [GovDash's Capturing FY27 Report Is Live](https://www.govdash.com/industry-reports/capturing-fy27) : $1.45T in defense spending, a $350B reconciliation ask narrowed to $60B, and $18B already pulled from live vehicles. Get the report before pricing your next FY27 bid.


4. [New Series: Inside MAPS, OASIS+, and MEGATRON](https://govdash.registration.goldcast.io/series/54b25657-bd42-4276-b20a-6093e7554abe) : A former ACC official breaks down MAPS scoring, USAF's newest vehicle, and FY26 data shows SBs outperforming OASIS+ assumptions. Hear from Katie Helwig, Dan Abernathy, Eric Nusbaum, Bryan J. Guinn, & Allison Gregory.


5. [SBA's Size Hikes Could Bundle Out Small Businesses](https://lnkd.in/p/gu6nSAnz) : Steven Koprince argues the SBA’s size hikes, some over 1k%, will drive bundling that prices out small businesses. Make your voice heard and comment by Sep 21.


6. [New Series: Pricing Under the Fixed-Price Default](https://govdash.registration.goldcast.io/series/ac2fdfd9-c8f7-42b3-bc35-e28a1e257e7a) : Price a real solicitation live against evaluator expectations. Get your teams in before your next bid, watch cost volume assumptions. Hear from Jenny W Clark, Brittany Winkler, Gizem Yilmaz, and Evan Allgair.


7. [GovCon Summer Social Sep 23 in VA](https://luma.com/govdash-qktd) : HH runs 5-7 PM at the Tower Club in Tysons, with food, drinks, and GovDash team. Register for face time with GovCon leaders before Q4 hits full speed. Chat with Andrew Flynn, Brett Kimble, HeeMin Kim, Michael D'Aniello, Shane Bowling, & Will Cotter.


8. [What FedTec's Exit Says About GovCon M&A](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/101-counting-fedtecs-exit-what-says-brand-govcon-ma-jason-siegel-avpce/) : Jason Siegel argues brand value, not just contract vehicles, is what buyers like Reply are actually paying for. Read the article if you’re weighing an exit or acquisition.


#### Award Intelligence


1. [Torch Locks $992M USAF Advisory IDIQ](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/019ff70b-b702-74da-8148-63da4c461d57--technical-and-management-advisory-services?searchId=01a03508-af9f-75fb-8a1a-b25127d545dd&position=1) : The award covers technical & mgmt advisory support across USAF programs. Review the TO queue now; it's becoming the default vehicle.


2. [GDIT Wins $1.3B ARNG Contract](https://www.gdit.com/about-gdit/press-releases/gdit-awarded-1-3-billion-enterprise-network-operations-and-cybersecurity-support-contract-for-the-army-national-guard/) : Scope covers enterprise network ops and cybersecurity support for ARNG. Lock in convos early; a contract this size sets staffing patterns for years.


3. [Parsons Beats 3 for $665M Army IDIQ](https://www.war.gov/News/Contracts/Contract/Article/4575681/contracts-for-aug-17-2026/#:~:text=the%20contracting%20activity%20(-,W31P4Q%2D26%2DF%2D0154,-).) : The vehicle covers technical, logistics, and program mgmt support across the Army. Study what separated the winners; this vehicle spins off TOs for years.


4. [Oracle Adds $568M DHS Cloud Task](https://www.usaspending.gov/award/CONT_IDV_70RTAC26D00000005_7001) : TO falls under Cumulus, DHS’s agency-wide com cloud program. Confirm your role if you partner with Oracle Federal; Cumulus is DHS’s cloud pathway.


5. [Canvas Wins $846M in USAF Test Contracts](https://www.canvas-inc.com/canvas-awarded-tmas-3-contracts-to-advance-air-force-test-capabilities/) : The TMAS 3 award funds new test capability dev across USAF. Watch for follow-on TOs, since it signals sustained investment in test infrastructure.


6. [Space Force Adds $615M in SB-AMTI Task Orders](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/08/space-force-awards-3-firms-615m-to-track-airborne-targets/) : Rocket Lab , STR, and an undisclosed third firm split the award. This builds on May’s $4.16B SpaceX award, pushing cumulative investment near $4.8B.


7. [DHS Names Counter-UAS Awardees, Anduril Fights for a Bigger Seat](https://www.usaspending.gov/search?hash=fd4f295c4d206061334b5db6d5b2775a) : The $1.5B C-UAS Comprehensive Services IDIQ named its winners; Anduril Industries is protesting after landing only a secondary tier. Watch how this resolves before assuming tier placement is final on similar vehicles.


8. [NOAA: $8B ProTech SBEM Domain IDIQ Awarded](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/019dd500-5b85-76d1-b85d-b90749d92bef--rfp-protech-space-based-environmental-monitoring-sbem-domain-idiq-and-to-1?searchId=01a04499-3670-73d9-8e64-1eaccafdaf5d&position=1) : NOAA awarded the $8B ProTech SBEM domain IDIQ. Map task order strategy now, since early orders set the incumbency pattern for years.


9. [FSA Secures $1B DOJ Asset Forfeiture Support Contract](https://www.usaspending.gov/award/CONT_IDV_15JPSS26D00000451_1501) : FSA secured a $1B DOJ Asset Forfeiture support contract. Firms with DOJ admin and financial credentials, study FSA’s positioning before the next recompete.


10. [Amentum Adds $974M NASA Langley Center Ops Win](https://www.amentum.com/news/amentum-wins-974m-center-maintenance-operations-and-engineering-contract-at-nasa-langley-research-center-2/) : Amentum secured a $974M NASA Langley Center Ops contract. This locks in its footprint for the award’s life and sets a high bar for the next recompete.


[GovCon Games](https://www.instagram.com/govcongames) - Stop introducing yourself from scratch. Turn one GovCon Games interview into months of reusable sales content. Show federal buyers & teaming partners your value before the meeting begins. Connect with GovCon Games[here.](https://www.instagram.com/govcongames)


#### Pipeline Ahead


1. [FAA Set to Give AT&T a Multi-Billion FENS Award](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/019ff628-721a-75cc-ba28-4f17db0679d8--faa-enterprise-network-services-fens) : The IDIQ covers the tech backbone for FAA’s new ATC system. Watch subcontract openings, since a vehicle this size rarely stays single-threaded.


2. [Megatron Gets a Ceiling: $4.5B+, September RFP](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/019fd325-9572-71d9-95de-9af7d33d3822--daf-battle-network-megatron-mac-idiq?searchId=01a03522-6aa5-700b-952e-1dcb8866c7f9&position=1) : USAF’s multi-award IDIQ consolidates XA and ABMS under new C3BM leadership. Start positioning now if you lack an ABMS or XA seat.


3. [CBP Preps $100M+ Steampunk SBIR Award](https://apfs-cloud.dhs.gov/record/74842/public-print/) : Phase III IDIQ funds the Design Intel Mission Mod Hub, converting SBIR-stage work into a durable vehicle. Study this pathway; it’s an SBIR foothold.


4. [NGA Bridges Signal Who Wins VERTEX](https://sam.gov/workspace/contract/opp/0d9942888b3549f5b95491b074652477/view) : MOJAVE bridge contracts keep work moving while VERTEX source selection finishes. Position now for bridge work if you’re outside the VERTEX pool.


5. [VA Opens ERP Integrator Role, Full and Open](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/019f04a6-1d4d-752e-aeaf-9de73047ee44--da01-enterprise-resource-planning-erp-system-integrator-si?searchId=01a03524-47d0-7713-8314-e3e8c6b4f95c&position=1) : The sources sought signal a wide-open competition with no incumbent advantage. Get your capability statement in now; full & open draws a crowd.


6. [USCIS Previews $100M+ Platform Deal](https://apfs-cloud.dhs.gov/record/74744/public-print/) : The Enterprise Platform Governance opportunity spans Salesforce, ServiceNow, M365, and UiPath. Map your multi-platform experience now.


7. [CISA Floats $6B Cyber Buying Model](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/019ff7ec-e0c9-77fd-b7dd-450d1190f781--cisa-strategic-cyber-tools-buying?searchId=01a03523-6c4d-706d-a42a-e304f55c9d52&position=1) : The RFI could consolidate how civilian agencies license security software. Respond if you sell cyber tooling; it reshapes how every future deal gets priced.


8. [NAVWAR Wants GenAI for Sailor Training. Deadline Sept 10](https://www.navwar.navy.mil/Work-With-Us/Open-CSO-Calls/Contact/) : CSO N0003925S001 calls for an offline-capable GenAI training tool with built-in security guardrails. Submit a five-page brief before the window closes.


9. [DHA Advances JOMIS Toward an FY27 Award](https://discover.govdash.com/solicitations/01a01023-e5ef-74d8-91a2-70a59d5fbb68--jomis-joint-medical-planning-modeling-and-simulation-capabilities?searchId=01a03534-63c1-7098-9fb0-4f6c1b6ff8c5&position=1) : The Data and Cloud Engineering competition supporting JOMIS is moving forward. Position now if you have DHA health IT credentials.


#### Regulatory Watch


1. [DOGE Can't Verify 96% of Its Savings](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-26-108615) : The “Wall of Receipts” claims $110B saved; GAO flagged a fictional $1.7B DHA cut. Don’t cite DOGE’s numbers to justify budget assumptions.


2. [SBA Rule Could Add 114K+ Small Businesses](https://govdash.ondemand.goldcast.io/on-demand/fd9b61e8-482e-420b-8e0b-6990fb58da88) : SBA’s overhaul would newly qualify ~114,500 firms as small, including 37,002 that already hold $71B in FY25 contracts. Reassess your competitive set now, since large incumbents may re-enter your set-aside space.


3. [SBA Moves 8(a) to Race-Neutral Standard](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/08/11/2026-16370/reforms-to-13-cfr-124103-to-remove-sbas-8a-programs-rebuttable-presumption-of-social-disadvantage) : Effective Sep 10, any U.S. citizen can establish social disadvantage via group-level evidence plus self-certification. Prepare your certifications now.


4. [VA OIG Flags $1.1B Benefits IT Risk](https://www.vaoig.gov/reports/audit/audit-program-management-benefits-enterprise-platform-modernization) : Schedule slips and cost growth have already drawn OIG scrutiny before major milestones hit. Build contingency into any proposal on this timeline.


5. [White House Names 14 Priority Areas for National Security R&D](https://www.whitehouse.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NSSTS-082026.pdf) : The strategy steers early-stage AI, quantum, and biotech toward public-private partnerships, and later-stage work toward direct buys. Map your capabilities against these priorities now; it calls for tighter security vetting.


6. [Army Can't Show Its Battlefield Network Modernization Is on Track](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-26-108019) : The Army requested $3.3B for NGC2 but has no full life-cycle cost estimate or fielding schedule through 2032. Build schedule risk into any NGC2-adjacent proposal, since this will likely drive tighter reporting requirements.


7. [HHS Falls Short on Payment Integrity Compliance for FY25](https://oig.hhs.gov/reports/all/2026/department-of-health-and-human-services-met-many-requirements-but-it-did-not-fully-comply-with-the-payment-integrity-information-act-of-2019-for-fiscal-year-2025/) : HHS OIG found the agency didn’t fully comply with the Payment Integrity Information Act. Expect closer scrutiny on any HHS program.


8. [Senate Dems Demand Clear AI Export Rules](https://www.warner.senate.gov/newsroom/press-releases/warner-colleagues-press-trump-administration-on-chaotic-opaque-oversight-of-new-artificial-intelligence-models/) : 5 senators cited abrupt access changes at Anthropic and OpenAI and demanded a public framework. Watch this, and follow Mark Warner if your AI vendors sell into federal accounts.


9. [GSA Uncovers $13B in Suspected Contractor Fraud](https://www.gsa.gov/about-gsa/newsroom/news-releases/gsa-uncovers-recordsetting-13-billion-in-suspected-procurement-fraud-08252026) : GSA said it uncovered $13B in suspected contractor fraud. Expect tighter invoice and compliance scrutiny across GSA vehicles as this number becomes ammunition for stricter oversight.
